name: atlas-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Atlas: the codebase-atlas CLI, its dashboard, the shared schema and the website.

scripts.build: npm run build:schema && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:cli
scripts.dev:dashboard: npm run build:schema && npm run dev -w codebase-atlas-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:schema && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
